title: Dunlop CX132
description:
Dunlop CX132
 The Dunlop CX132 is the racket for players who leave nothing to chance and are always looking for maximum control over their game. Thanks to the big 500 cm² racket head, you not only get a larger contact area, but also that extra punch that gives your shots more depth and power. This makes the Dunlop CX132 ideal for players who want precision, but need that little bit of extra power at decisive moments to surprise their opponent.

An important feature of the Dunlop CX132 is the dense 16x19 string pattern. Because the gaps between the strings are relatively small, you have more string contact with the ball. This translates into exceptional ball feel and precise control, allowing you to place the ball with surgical precision. Combine that with the low balance point, and you get a racket that is extremely manoeuvrable. The Dunlop CX132 invites you to choose the attack, play aggressively and stay one step ahead of your opponent. It's no coincidence that top players such as world champion Diego Elias and talented Jonah Bryant rely on the Dunlop CX132 during the biggest tournaments..

In terms of equipment, the Dunlop CX132 leaves nothing to be desired. The racket is strung with the Iconic Pro AF 1,22 string, which is known for its feel and consistency. In addition, the Hydramax Pro grip comes as standard, ensuring an excellent mix of grip and moisture absorption – even during intense rallies.

The technologies incorporated into the Dunlop CX132 make all the difference. Sonic Core, strategically placed at 2 and 10 o'clock, enlarges the sweet spot and dampens vibrations, so every shot feels solid and comfortable. In the throat of the racket, Flex Touch Resin provides even more feel and a smooth touch, giving you optimal confidence with every shot.

In short, the Dunlop CX132 combines control, manoeuvrability, power and comfort in one impressive package. Whether you're controlling the rally with precision or striking with a powerful winner, this racket gives you the tools to pull every point towards you.

title: Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 NS Airshaft
description:
Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 NS Airshaft
 The Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 NS Airshaft has a thinner grip which makes it very suitable for players with smaller hands. For the rest, the racket is almost identical to the Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 Airshaft. All

are the same except for the balance point which is slightly higher. The beautiful colour combination makes this top racket a real eye catcher. It is the signature racket of the Egyptian Nour El Sherbini who has achieved a great success with her Carboflex rackets. She is a multiple world champion and has been in the top ten of the world ranking for a long time.

The frame of the Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 NS Airshaft weighs just 125 grams and the slightly higher balance point makes it easy to generate a lot of racket acceleration for powerful shots. The teardrop shaped frame means that the main strings can move more freely and the ball leaves the strings with a very high speed. New grommets with larger openings are situated in strategic places in the frame. The string bed has more freedom of movement, making the new Carboflex Airshaft rackets especially forgiving: you can control the ball even if you hit it outside the centre of the blade.

Tecnifbre has done a great job on the top of the shaft and the result is highly improved aerodynamics. Thanks to the streamlined design, the Tecnifibre Carboflex 125 NS Airshaft experiences virtually no air resistance and you can therefore react faster. In turn, your opponent has less time to recover the T position. To make the racket construction more stable, there are new X shaped reinforcements in the shaft.

title: Dunlop CX125
description:
Dunlop CX125
 The Dunlop CX125 is the racket for players who want complete control over their game. With its compact racket head and conventional bridge shape, you get a direct and honest feel for the ball: every shot is transmitted exactly, allowing you to control the ball with extreme precision. This makes the Dunlop CX125 the perfect choice for players who rely on technique, placement and timing to outsmart their opponents.

The low balance point – with most of the weight in the bottom of the frame – makes the Dunlop CX125 feel incredibly manoeuvrable. This allows you to react faster, hit the ball earlier and generate a lot of racket acceleration with a short swing. Whether you choose to attack early or wait to trap your opponent at the T, this racket always gives you the opportunity to take the initiative.

Weighing just 125 grams, the Dunlop CX125 is the lightest conventional model in the CX collection. Top player Aly Abou Eleinen relies on this racket for good reason. Known for his attractive and energetic playing style, he demonstrates how versatile and powerful the Dunlop CX125 is – and how this racket can help you make your own game creative and dynamic.

In terms of finish, the Dunlop CX125 offers everything you need to deliver top performance. The racket comes strung with the Iconic Pro AF 1,22 string as standard, which gives you exceptional feel and feedback with every shot. The Hydramax Pro grip provides the perfect blend of grip and moisture absorption, allowing you to maintain maximum control in every rally, even during long and intense matches.

The technology in the Dunlop CX125 takes it to an even higher level. Sonic Core, positioned at 2 and 10 o'clock, enlarges the sweet spot and dampens vibrations for a stable and comfortable feel with every stroke. In the neck of the racket, Flex Touch Resin provides even more feel and touch, giving you the confidence to make the right decisions under pressure. The result is a racket that is not only fast and light, but also delivers an exceptionally high level of comfort and control.

In short: the Dunlop CX125 is perfect for players who want to combine ultimate precision with speed and manoeuvrability. With this racket in your hand, you have the control, feel and dynamics to make the difference at any moment.

title: Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro
description:
Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro
 The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro has been developed in collaboration with the highly talented Egyptian player Ali Farag. The racket has an extra-elongated teardrop racket head with the longitudinal strings reaching all the way through to the shaft. As a result, the string bed can move much more and this creates a lot of power. The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro is therefore especially suitable for an aggressive playing style.

Hyperfibre+ has been added at three strategic locations in the frame. This ballistic fibre increases the stiffness of the racket and provides more power and stability: the racket blade of the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro maintains very stable during a shot and the response of the string bed is excellent. The extra reinforcements in the top of the frame provide extra protection against damage. The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro has a head heavy balance and the extra weight in the top guarantees unparalleled racket acceleration.

The frame of the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro only weighs 128 grams and the racket head has a surface of 490 cm2. Due to the close string pattern of 14 x 19 the openings between the strings are relatively small and this provides a lot of ball control. The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro frame is a particularly aerodynamic racket: the Aeroskin CX technology, a sharkskin-inspired structure applied to the outside of the frame, significantly reduces aerodynamic drag. This innovative technology, tested in a wind tunnel, has been proved to reduce the air resistance of the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro by as much as 35%.

The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Revelation Pro is an ideal racket for the squash player with an explosive and attacking playing style.

title: Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium
description:
Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium
 The Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium offers you exceptional power. This model from the very popular Blackstorm series by Dunlop has a large teardrop-shaped racket head of no less than 500 cm2. The racket doesn’t have a bridge in the frame and the strings run all the way down to the shaft of the Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium, giving the string bed more freedom of movement and extra acceleration to the ball. You can therefore effortlessly hit powerful shots and put your opponent under pressure with explosive play.

The Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium feels very light and is extremely agile due to the extra head light balance. The racket weighs only 125 grams and most weight is located in the bottom of the frame making the Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium very agile. With this racket you can hit the ball earlier or choose to hold your shot to disguise your intentions, and yet create enough power with a short swing. The Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium has a very large sweet spot (= the ideal place to hit the ball) and is therefore very forgiving. Even balls that you hit close to the frame can still be controlled. The relatively small openings between the strings contribute to the fantastic ball control qualities of this racket.

Dunlop has added 4D Braided material, extremely light composite fibres woven in four directions, in two places of the frame in order to improve the absorption of the torsion forces caused by the impact of the ball. The racket head of the Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium maintains more stable during a shot and you can place the ball exactly where you want. Furthermore, the Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium has a Powermax string pattern that provides extra strength and an even larger sweet spot. At the lower part of the racket head, not one but two strings come out of each tubing and they run in a fan shape.

The Dunlop Blackstorm Titanium is the perfect choice for the recreational player who is looking for a very light racket with unrivalled strength and extreme manoeuvrability.

title: Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro
description:
Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro
 The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro is the racket of Nick Matthew, one of the most successful squash players of all time. The playing characteristics of this racket fit perfectly his aggressive playing style with a lot of volleys and attacking shots. The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro has a hybrid frame with a small bridge and it therefore offers a perfect combination of strength and control. The longitudinal strings are slightly longer than in a conventional racket and can move more freely. During a shot the trampoline-effect is greater and the ball gets extra acceleration. Because the racket head is still compact and the openings between the strings relatively small, you can also enjoy fantastic precision.

Dunlop has added ballistic fibres (Hyperfibre+) in two places at the top of the frame to significantly improve the playing characteristics of the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro. First, the frame is even stiffer, providing you with improved control over every shot. Second, the extra weight in the top of the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro provides more racket acceleration. Finally, the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro is stronger at two critical places that are especially prone to damage when you scratch the side wall. The racket is therefore more durable and less likely to break when you hit the ball that is 'glued' to the side wall.

The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro has an extraordinarily light frame of only 120 grams. Since most weight is located in the bottom of the racket, the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro is extremely agile and therefore ideal for an attacking playing style. The racket head has a surface of 490 cm2. The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro is extremely aerodynamic thanks to the narrow profile of the frame and the ridge structure that has been applied on the outside of the racket. This technology, tested in the wind tunnel, is inspired by natural sharkskin and significantly reduces air resistance of the racket. Parallel Strung technology means that the strings in the hitting zone are exactly parallel, making the sweet spot of the racket even bigger. This makes the Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro extraordinarily forgiving: even balls that are hit close to the frame can still be controlled.

The Dunlop Hyperfibre+ Evolution Pro is a racket with fantastic playing characteristics. It´s suitable for the player who seeks nothing less than the optimal combination of strength, mobility and control.

 The Dunlop CX120 is the updated version of the legendary racket with which Nick Matthew celebrated years of success. This update combines the rich history of a top racket with the latest technology, giving you an unprecedented blend of control and power. Thanks to the hybrid frame – with a small bridge – the racket head feels compact and precise, but at the same time you benefit from the longer main string that adds extra power. The result: the Dunlop CX120 offers the perfect balance between feel, precision and power, making it a versatile all-round racket for ambitious players.

You can volley the ball effortlessly, pick it up faster and change the direction of your shots at the last moment. This makes the Dunlop CX120 ideal for players who like to control the T and set the pace with dominant play. Whether you attack in the rally or subtly place the ball, this racket always gives you the freedom to choose.

Weighing 120 grams, the Dunlop CX120 is also light enough to move quickly, but sturdy enough to guarantee stability and impact resistance. It is precisely this balance that makes this racket suitable for a wide range of players – from competitive club players to ambitious tournament winners. The Dunlop CX120 gives you the versatility you need to make a difference in any situation.

When it comes to finish, Dunlop delivers only the best. The racket comes strung with the Iconic Pro AF 1,22 string, which gives you great feel on every shot and the control to place the ball precisely. The Hydramax Pro grip provides excellent grip and moisture absorption, giving you maximum confidence even during the toughest rallies.

Modern technology takes this racket even further. Sonic Core, strategically placed at 2 and 10 o'clock in the frame, enlarges the sweet spot and reduces vibrations. This makes every shot feel stable and comfortable, even when you don't hit the ball perfectly in the centre. In addition, Flex Touch Resin in the throat of the racket provides even more touch and feel, so you can play even the most subtle drops and lobs with confidence.
